about: A late-summer crayfish party in the garden: paper hats, a paper moon lantern, bibs at the table.

pieces.name: partyhat
pieces.about: A paper party hat with a red crayfish printed on it, worn on the crown at a late-summer crayfish party.

pieces.name: moonlantern
pieces.about: A round paper lantern with a smiling moon face, hung from a bamboo pole carried behind the shoulder, as lanterns light a crayfish party in the garden.

pieces.name: moonlantern-swing
pieces.about: The moon lantern swinging on its pole, worn behind the shoulder while the Cell cheers.
